title: Complete ResultSafe public contract catalog
summary: Contract records for every runtime and type symbol exported by the current TypeScript Result package, classified by neutral semantics.

items.title: ResultData and runtime Result split
items.signature_model: ResultData<T,E> = SuccessData<T> | FailureData<E>; Result<T,E> = methodful language projection; ResultLike<T,E> = Result<T,E> | ResultData<T,E>
behavior: Defines an exclusive two-variant generic sum type
Carries a success payload T or failure payload E but never both
Keeps language-neutral transport data free of behavior members
Requires explicit hydration to restore a canonical runtime wrapper after JSON, clone, spread, assignment, or cross-copy boundaries
Allows free TypeScript Result functions to accept ResultLike while Result-valued outputs remain methodful
Offers optional structured Failure as an explicit E payload without constraining generic Result, Err, or FailureData branch semantics

items.title: Option type
behavior: Represents presence or absence without a null sentinel
Supports Result conversion and transpose operations

items.title: Async validator function
behavior: Resolves true for accepted input and false for rejected input
Rejection propagates through async refinement

items.title: Payload keys
behavior: Derives configured payload keys without a magic string sentinel
Empty key collection represents no payload

items.title: Validator function
behavior: Runtime predicate output is the only evidence for a concrete refined type
Thrown exceptions propagate unless an operation explicitly maps them

items.title: Variant configuration
items.signature_model: payload keys plus strict and forbidden field policy
behavior: Payload keys are explicit and ordered
Strict fields reject undeclared own fields
Forbidden fields reject presence regardless of value

items.title: Variant handler
behavior: A handler is associated with exactly one variant key
Callback input narrows to the matching branch

items.title: Strict match builder
behavior: Each with removes one remaining variant
Run becomes available only when no variants remain
Handler outputs accumulate

items.title: Fallback matcher
behavior: With accumulates handlers without loss
Otherwise handles only unmatched input and enables run

items.title: Synchronous refined result
behavior: Configured present fields are represented
Validator predicates determine concrete field types and unvalidated fields remain unknown

items.title: Synchronous refined result union
items.signature_model: union of refined variants from a complete map
behavior: Produces one branch per configured variant
Preserves branch-specific payload types

items.title: Synchronous validator map
behavior: Validators align with configured variant payload keys
Unknown validator keys are rejected by the type projection

items.title: Universal async refined result
behavior: Represents fields actually established by async validation
Does not claim concrete field types without explicit schema output evidence

items.title: Universal refined result
behavior: Represents the selected variant and established payload fields
Does not widen to arbitrary unvalidated string fields

items.title: Variant union member
behavior: A union of keys produces a union of individually discriminated object types
Supports branch extraction by a specific key

items.title: Success constructor
behavior: Creates an immutable SUCCESS wrapper
Preserves the exact payload reference
Cannot create a failure branch

items.title: Failure constructor
behavior: Creates an immutable FAILURE wrapper
Preserves the exact error payload reference
Cannot create a success branch

items.title: Failure guard
behavior: Returns true only for the exact FAILURE discriminator
Narrows to the concrete failure branch

items.title: Failure predicate guard
items.signature_model: Result<T,E> x predicate<E> -> boolean or narrowed failure
behavior: Invokes the predicate exactly once on FAILURE
Never invokes the predicate on SUCCESS
Propagates predicate exceptions

items.title: Success guard
behavior: Returns true only for the exact SUCCESS discriminator
Narrows to the concrete success branch

items.title: Success predicate guard
items.signature_model: Result<T,E> x predicate<T> -> boolean or narrowed success
behavior: Invokes the predicate exactly once on SUCCESS
Never invokes the predicate on FAILURE
Propagates predicate exceptions

items.title: Chain success
behavior: Invokes the callback once on SUCCESS and returns its Result
Returns FAILURE unchanged without callback invocation
Propagates callback exceptions

items.title: Failure payload Option
behavior: Returns Some error on FAILURE
Returns immutable None on SUCCESS

items.title: Expect success
items.signature_model: Result<T,E> x message -> T or extraction failure
behavior: Returns the success payload
Throws the projection extraction failure with the supplied message on FAILURE

items.title: Expect failure
items.signature_model: Result<T,E> x message -> E or extraction failure
behavior: Returns the failure payload
Throws the projection extraction failure with the supplied message on SUCCESS

items.title: Flatten nested Result
behavior: Returns the inner Result from SUCCESS
Returns equivalent FAILURE from the outer failure branch

items.title: Inspect success alias
items.signature_model: alias of tap in the TypeScript projection
behavior: Has identical semantics to tap
Exists as a projection alias rather than a separate canonical primitive

items.title: Inspect failure alias
items.signature_model: alias of tapErr in the TypeScript projection
behavior: Has identical semantics to tapErr
Exists as a projection alias rather than a separate canonical primitive

items.title: Map success
behavior: Invokes mapper exactly once on SUCCESS and wraps the output
Does not invoke mapper on FAILURE and preserves the failure payload
Propagates mapper exceptions

items.title: Map failure
behavior: Invokes mapper exactly once on FAILURE and wraps the output
Does not invoke mapper on SUCCESS and preserves the success payload
Propagates mapper exceptions

items.title: Match Result
items.signature_model: Result<T,E> x (T -> A) x (E -> B) -> A | B
behavior: Invokes exactly the active branch callback once
Returns the selected callback output
Propagates callback exceptions

items.title: Success payload Option
behavior: Returns Some value on SUCCESS
Returns immutable None on FAILURE

items.title: Recover failure
behavior: Invokes recovery once on FAILURE and returns its Result
Returns SUCCESS unchanged without recovery invocation
Propagates recovery exceptions

items.title: Tap success
behavior: Invokes effect once on SUCCESS
Never invokes effect on FAILURE
Returns semantically unchanged input and propagates effect exceptions

items.title: Tap failure
behavior: Invokes effect once on FAILURE
Never invokes effect on SUCCESS
Returns semantically unchanged input and propagates effect exceptions

items.title: Transpose Result and Option
behavior: SUCCESS Some becomes Some SUCCESS
SUCCESS None becomes None
FAILURE becomes Some FAILURE

items.title: Unwrap success
behavior: Returns success payload
Throws a stable extraction failure on FAILURE and preserves the failure payload as diagnostic cause

items.title: Unwrap failure
behavior: Returns failure payload
Throws a stable extraction failure on SUCCESS and preserves the success payload as diagnostic cause

items.title: Unwrap or value
behavior: Returns success payload on SUCCESS
Returns eagerly provided fallback on FAILURE

items.title: Unwrap or lazy fallback
behavior: Returns success payload without callback
Invokes fallback exactly once with failure payload
Propagates fallback exceptions

items.title: Tagged variant guard
behavior: Requires a non-null object with an own type field
Requires exact discriminator equality
Does not assert payload shape

items.title: Validated tagged variant guard
items.signature_model: variant key x runtime schema -> unknown -> validated predicate
behavior: Requires own discriminator and payload fields
Invokes explicit validators
Infers only validator-established payload types

items.title: Match tagged variant with fallback
items.signature_model: tagged union -> accumulated handlers -> fallback -> output union
behavior: Preserves arbitrary-length handler registration order
Runs the first matching handler
Runs fallback only when no handler matches
Accumulates output types

items.title: Exhaustive tagged variant match
items.signature_model: tagged union -> exhaustive accumulated handlers -> output union
behavior: Preserves every registered handler
Prevents run until all static variants are handled
Throws an unmatched-variant failure only for runtime contract violation

items.title: Curried async variant refinement
items.signature_model: map -> variant -> async validators -> unknown -> Awaitable<variant|null>
behavior: Uses the same field rules as synchronous refinement
Validates sequentially in payload-key order
Stops on first false and propagates rejection

items.title: Direct async variant refinement
items.signature_model: unknown x variant x map x async validators -> Awaitable<variant|null>
behavior: Is semantically equivalent to the curried async form
Delegates to one shared async validation kernel

items.title: Curried synchronous variant refinement
behavior: Requires own discriminator and configured payload presence
Applies strict and forbidden policies
Invokes validators in payload-key order and returns original value on success

items.title: Direct synchronous variant refinement
items.signature_model: unknown x variant x map x validators -> variant|null
behavior: Is semantically equivalent to the curried synchronous form
Delegates to one shared synchronous validation kernel

items.title: Full-map variant refinement
items.signature_model: unknown x complete map x validator map -> refined union|null
behavior: Requires an own known discriminator
Uses own map and validator properties only
Returns a branch-specific validator-derived type or null
